texte.Rapprochez la dépense du taux d’usage ré: Compare spending with the actual usage rate: share of the team using it, time given back, drop-off at ninety days.

texte.Rassemblez sources, millésimes, hypothès: Gather sources, editions, assumptions and calculation methods.

Before classifying a system, you first need to know that it exists.
texte.Recensez au Registre les systèmes que vo: Record in the register the systems you intend to include in the reporting, with their model, their billing unit and their volume for the month.
texte.Recensez chaque traitement de données av: List each data processing activity with the particulars required by Article #.
texte.Recensez d’abord vos systèmes (Registre: First list your systems (AI register), then classify them (simulator), and finally assess them (audit, FRIA). Auditing an unclassified system wastes time: the obligations depend on the class.
texte.Recensez les outils d’IA déjà employés d: List the AI tools already in use in the organisation without having gone through a decision: browser extensions, assistants built into office suites, subscriptions taken out by a team.
texte.Recensez les systèmes d’IA en service, e: List the AI systems in service and, for each one, the model used, the billing unit, the volumes for the month AND THEIR SOURCE.
texte.Recensez les systèmes en service, y comp: List the systems in service, including those that arrived without going through you.
texte.Recensez les traitements de données pers: List the personal data processing carried out by each AI system.

Reload the page rather than reading an incomplete verdict.

texte.Refaites cette étape après chaque affina: Redo this step after each fine-tuning or change of use: the role is not acquired once and for all.

texte.Refus, tarif, score, orientation, sancti: Refusal, price, score, referral, sanction. The data subject has the right to know who answers for it.
texte.Regardez aussi les projets ARRÊTÉS. Un s: Also look at the STOPPED projects. A site abandoned during permitting tells you more about a geography than ten inaugurations.
texte.Regardez ce que le cadre NIST apporte qu: Look at what the NIST framework brings that the European texts do not.
texte.Regardez ce que le travail déjà fait ail: Look at what the work already done elsewhere saves you here.
texte.Regardez d’abord ce qui change le PÉRIMÈ: First look at what changes the reporting SCOPE — a threshold that drops brings in sites that were not concerned, and that is more costly than one more indicator.
texte.Regardez d’abord la ligne « aucune ». Ce: Look first at the “none” row. Those risks are application-level, and ISO/IEC # is a management system: no framework will catch them, they are treated in the application. They are also the ones you believe you are covered for precisely because you are certified.
texte.Regardez d’abord les lignes où la colonn: First look at the rows where the controls column is empty.
texte.Regardez la COUVERTURE avant les montant: Look at the COVERAGE before the amounts: a cost calculated on three declared systems out of twelve is not a budget, it is a sample.
texte.Regardez la DATE de mise à jour de la fi: Look at the update DATE of the profile before drawing a decision from it: a country’s severity moves faster than the map.
texte.Regardez la colonne CRA en face de vos m: Look at the CRA column opposite your existing modules.
texte.Regardez la colonne NIS # en face de vos: Look at the NIS # column opposite your existing modules.
texte.Regardez le compteur « non décidées » av: Look at the “not decided” counter before all the others. Thirty-six controls implemented and two empty boxes: the stage # audit stops. Eighteen included and twenty excluded, each one justified: it passes. Excluding is a right, not an admission — what costs is not deciding. Write the reason AT THE MOMENT you decide: those drafted three months later never resemble the decision taken.
texte.Regardez le compteur « non décidées ». C: Look at the “not decided” counter. It is the one that decides whether the audit takes place.
texte.Regardez le palier auquel l’article # vo: Look at the tier to which Article # exposes you.
texte.Regardez le pont vers # : il liste exact: Look at the bridge to #: it lists exactly what grafts on.
texte.Regardez le rapprochement mesure par mes: Look at the measure-by-measure mapping between Article #(#) and Annex A.
texte.Regardez les cinq lignes, et surtout laq: Look at the five rows, and above all which of the five is NOT an obligation.

Look at the five rows, and above all which of the five is NOT an obligation. Four are — approval, oversight, liability, training of the MANAGERS —, the fifth, staff training, is an encouragement. The rate displayed counts only the four: adding it would give points to a company that has trained all its teams but not its board, that is, one that has missed the only one of the two trainings that exposes it personally. Each row says what EVIDENCE is expected, and that is where the gap between believing you comply and complying is played out.
texte.Regardez les délais que votre client doi: Look at the deadlines your client must meet: they are the ones that set yours.
texte.Regardez l’écart entre ce qui a été dépl: Look at the gap between what has been deployed and what is opened — a compliant tool that nobody opens produces nothing.
texte.Regardez l’écart entre les deux paliers: Look at the gap between the two tiers for YOUR turnover.
texte.Regardez l’écart entre les personnes for: Look at the gap between the people trained and the tools actually opened.
texte.Regardez à quel palier vos manquements e: Look at which tier your failings expose you to, and from what turnover the percentage exceeds the fixed amount.

texte.Relevez, pour chaque valeur que vous com: For each value you intend to quote, note whether it is published, calculated from the site or inferred from a class — the tooltip says so every time.
texte.Relie l’exposition à des faits vérifiabl: Links the exposure to verifiable facts rather than to a general fear.
texte.Relisez vos évaluations enregistrées ave: Re-read your saved assessments with their score and their recommendations, in the order in which they were made.
texte.Rempli sans être vécu, il documente une: Filled in without being lived, it documents a compliance that does not exist — and that is exactly what an inspection seeks to distinguish.
texte.Rend visible une dépendance souvent mal: Makes visible a dependency that is often poorly mapped: who uses which data, and for what.
texte.Rendez obligatoire le module de base pou: Make the core module mandatory for anyone involved in an AI project, from the day they arrive.
texte.Renseignez d'abord votre qualification :: First enter your qualification: the page refuses to calculate without it, and that refusal is the first service it renders. The principle of proportionality reserves objectives # to # for essential entities, and reduces the number of means expected for fifteen others — # for an essential entity, # for an important entity, exactly half. It is the first text in which the essential / important distinction changes THE MEASURES, and not only the supervision and the ceiling on fines.
texte.Renseignez d’abord le socle #-# : sans l: First fill in the #-# baseline: without it, each axis is capped at zero and the rate says nothing. Then go down the axes in order — safety comes first because it takes precedence over security, and not the other way round.
texte.Renseignez d’abord les six catégories de: First fill in the six GOVERN categories, before touching the other three functions.

First fill in the six GOVERN categories. If one of the other three functions gets ahead of it by a full point, the screen says so: you are mapping, measuring or treating risks that nobody has committed to owning. The gap is closed from the top, never by slowing down the downstream. Distinguish “held” from “proven”: the two look alike in a workshop and part ways in a review.
texte.Renseignez la base légale du traitement: Enter the legal basis of the processing as soon as it is recorded: it is the field nobody can find six months later.
texte.Renseignez la même qualification qu’à l’: Enter the same qualification as in step #, and look at what France will ask of you in the list.
texte.Renseignez le périmètre le plus précisém: Describe the scope as precisely as possible: number of systems, sector, target deadline. You can invite colleagues to contribute before sending. The sharper the scope, the more accurate the proposal.
texte.Renseignez le secteur et la taille, puis: Enter the sector and the size, then open “the cases where size does not matter”: eight doors ignore size entirely, and two lead directly to essential entity status. Beware of the “OR” in the financial thresholds — €# million in turnover with €# million in balance sheet remains a MEDIUM-sized enterprise, because meeting just one of the two ceilings is enough. Reading it as an “AND” over-qualifies.
texte.Renseignez le secteur et la taille. Ouvr: Enter the sector and the size. Then open “the cases where size does not matter”.
texte.Renseignez les dix axes. Chacun affiche: Fill in the ten axes. Each one displays the #-# families it tailors, and the number of controls that Appendix G adjusts in it.
texte.Renseignez les faits, pas votre conclusi: Enter the facts, not your conclusion: the tool qualifies on the basis of objective elements (role, purpose, data, sector). Each answer carries its basis, to be checked before relying on it.
texte.Renseignez sur chaque système le modèle: For each system, enter the model used, the billing unit, the volumes for the month and THEIR SOURCE. Eight fields, and eight only: everything else — the department, the owner, the risk level, the lifecycle stage — is already in the register, and this page READS it instead of asking you for it again.
texte.Repartir avec le redécoupage écrit d'un: Leave with the written redesign of a real process: what the machine does, what the human keeps, WHAT DISAPPEARS and who arbitrates.
